sources.credit: WhichMuseum collection photograph, see linked page
sources.observation: White metal window frames divide paired windows beneath the projecting entrance gable. Peach plaster and pale roof tiles contrast with the rough dark stone plinth. Broad, shallow steps connect to the entrance courtyard.

limitations: The model covers the principal museum exterior. Roof crest heights and window subdivisions are estimated from the courtyard photograph and the aerial view credited to Aegis Trust.
